purpose: Owner-requested breathing, blinking and personality gestures for the six players and eighteen NPCs
processing: Generated PNGs are unchanged copies. Source-pixel cells and silhouettes are analysed for runtime registration; SVG clipping and upper-body transforms animate the original pixels.

sheets.prompt: Create a four-direction STANDING neutral idle atlas of the SIX existing player characters C01-1 through C01-6. Preserve EXACT six identities, column order, clothes, colors and detailed crisp pixel-art B style from reference. SIX columns FOUR rows, 24 complete full-body figures. Row1 SOUTH straight front; row2 NORTH straight back; row3 EAST right side profile; row4 WEST left side profile. Both feet planted naturally, arms relaxed, eyes open where visible, NO walking or gestures, no three-quarter turns. Exact consistent scale and feet baseline per cell across directions. Figures occupy ONLY70%of own cell height, with15%padding top/bottom and generous side margins, especially last row shoes. Square transparent canvas, no labels text gridlines shadows scenery. All feet and hair fully inside cells.

Create an eye-BLINK sprite atlas for the SIX existing player characters C01-1 through C01-6 from the supplied identity reference. Preserve exact identities, column order, clothing, hair, skin, goggles/glasses and detailed crisp pixel-art B style. SIX columns FOUR rows, 24 complete full-body neutral STANDING figures, both feet planted, relaxed arms, same head/body scale and feet baseline per cell. Row1 SOUTH straight front view with eyes gently CLOSED in a natural brief blink; row2 NORTH straight back view unchanged (no visible eyes); row3 EAST right side profile eyes gently CLOSED; row4 WEST left side profile eyes gently CLOSED. Eyelids are quiet horizontal closed lines, not winking, crying or sleeping. Keep goggles and spectacle frames over closed eyes. NO walking, gestures or identity changes. Figures occupy ONLY70%cell height with15%padding top and bottom in EVERY equal cell, especially last-row shoes. Transparent square canvas. No text labels gridlines shadows scenery. All shoes hair and props fully inside cells.

Create a genuine three-keyframe idle personality animation atlas of the SIX existing player characters C01-1 through C01-6. Preserve exact six identities, column order, outfits, hair, skin colors and detailed crisp pixel-art B style from reference. SIX columns THREE rows =18 full-body SOUTH/FRONT facing STANDING figures. Each column is the SAME character across rows. Every character keeps feet planted in same position; same scale, head size and alignment, no stepping or walking or camera turn. Column1 teal-jacket student checks a wristwatch; column2 cream-sweater student quietly chews gum and blows one small bubble; column3 blue-hoodie student stretches shoulders; column4 black-bob student briefly raises one arm for a discreet comic underarm sniff; column5 blond student adjusts glasses; column6 green-jacket student tucks curly hair behind ear. ROW1 anticipation/start of the assigned gesture, ROW2 clear readable peak of that same gesture, ROW3 recovery/end of the gesture before neutral stance. Each column's THREE poses must be meaningfully different frames of ONLY its assigned action. Props small and close to body, ball never higher than head, don't let props replace hands or merge with face. Hand and head motion should describe action naturally. Faces visible with eyes open except sniff glance. No text or drawn motion lines. Transparent canvas 4:3 landscape, equally spaced six-column three-row grid. Figures occupy ONLY70%of equal cell height with15%padding top/bottom of every cell, ample margins around feet hair arms props. Absolutely all18 full figures/shoes inside canvas including lastrow. No scenery shadows gridlines or labels.
